extracted.intended_audience: members of the public and stakeholders preparing comments on EPA pesticide registration review dockets (e.g., environmental and human health advocates, farm worker and agricultural groups, the chemical industry, pesticide users, and interested members of the public)
extracted.subtask_short: commenting on EPA pesticide registration reviews
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting public comments on EPA registration review work plans and case dockets for pesticides, including what materials are in the dockets, procedural requirements (deadlines, submission methods), and handling of confidential business information (CBI).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments must be received by the closing date
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received on or before February 9, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All comments should be submitted using the methods in ADDRESSES and must be received by the EPA on or before the closing date. These comments will become part of the docket for the pesticides included in Table 1 of Unit I.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit comments via specified methods (regs.gov or mail)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your comments to the docket identification (ID) number for the specific pesticide by one of the specified methods: Federal eRulemaking Portal (https://www.regulations.gov) or mail to the OPP Docket at EPA/DC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the online instructions for submitting comments on Regulations.gov. Do not submit electronically any information you consider to be Confidential Business Information (CBI) or other information whose disclosure is restricted by statute; see the CBI handling guidance in this notice. Mailing address: OPP Docket, Environmental Protection Agency Docket Center (EPA/DC), (28221T), 1200 Pennsylvania Ave. NW, Washington, DC 20460-0001.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidential Business Information (CBI) handling requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not submit CBI to EPA through regulations.gov or email. Clearly mark the part or all of the information that you claim to be CBI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For CBI information in a disk or CD-ROM you mail to EPA, mark the outside of the disk or CD-ROM as CBI and then identify electronically within the disk or CD-ROM the specific information that is claimed as CBI. In addition to one complete version of the comment that includes information claimed as CBI, submit a copy of the comment that does not contain the information claimed as CBI for inclusion in the public docket. Information so marked will not be disclosed except in accordance with procedures set forth in 40 CFR part 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use docket materials to identify what to comment on
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA initiates a registration review by establishing a public docket that contains information to assist the public in understanding the issues the Agency has considered during registration review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistent with 40 CFR 155.50(a), dockets may include an overview of the registration review case status, a list of current product registrations and registrants, any Federal Register notices regarding pending registration actions, any Federal Register notices regarding current or pending tolerances, risk assessments, bibliographies concerning current registrations, summaries of incident data, and any other pertinent data or information. EPA includes a Preliminary Work Plan (PWP), and in some cases a Continuing Work Plan (CWP), summarizing information EPA has on the pesticide and the anticipated path forward. The docket also identifies the areas where public comment is specifically requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify additional information the Agency should consider
rubrics_metrics.description: During the public comment period, interested persons should identify any additional information they believe the Agency should consider during the registration reviews of these pesticides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The comment period is intended to provide an opportunity for public input and a mechanism for initiating any necessary changes to a pesticide's workplan. While the Agency identifies in each docket the areas where public comment is specifically requested, comment in any area is welcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment period length and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA provides for at least a 60-day public comment period on work plans and registration review dockets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This period is intended to solicit public input and allow for initiation of changes to the workplan. It is consistent with 40 CFR 155.50(b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expectations about agency handling and availability of submitted comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies review all submissions and may choose to redact, or withhold, certain submissions (or portions thereof). Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments will become part of the docket; the Agency will consider all comments received by the closing date and may respond to comments in a 'Response to Comments Memorandum' in the docket or the Final Work Plan (FWP), as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact the Chemical Review Manager for pesticide-specific questions
rubrics_metrics.description: For pesticide specific information, contact the Chemical Review Manager for the pesticide of interest identified in Table 1 of Unit I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have questions regarding the applicability of this action to a particular entity or pesticide, consult the Chemical Review Manager listed in Table 1 (contact names, emails, and phone numbers are provided). For general questions on the registration review program, contact the listed program official (Melanie Biscoe, with phone and email).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory and regulatory framework guiding registration review
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA is conducting registration review pursuant to FIFRA section 3(g) (7 U.S.C. 136a(g)) and the Procedural Regulations for Registration Review at 40 CFR part 155, subpart C.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FIFRA section 3(g) provides that pesticide registrations are to be reviewed every 15 years. Consistent with 40 CFR 155.57, the final registration review decision will determine whether a pesticide continues to meet the registration standard in FIFRA section 3(c)(5) (7 U.S.C. 136a(c)(5)). Refer to 40 CFR part 155 for procedural details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use EPA commenting tips and guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: When preparing and submitting your comments, see the commenting tips at https://www.epa.gov/dockets/commenting-epa-dockets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The tips provide practical guidance for formatting and submitting comments to EPA dockets; follow those tips in addition to the submission methods and CBI instructions in this notice.
